description: Life inside the summit position. A Vietnamese woman in a gray blouse and long dark skirt stands with a small child in red among deep sandbag walls — the foreground is an expanse of weathered, bulging sandbags. Behind her, a lean-to shelter of lashed poles and canvas holds household-military bricolage: ammunition cans, a large square tin, cooking pots, a white helmet liner, wooden crates, and a folding stretcher used as a shelf. Boulders rise at right with faint painted characters; beyond, the cloud layer again lies BELOW the camera. This is domestic life at altitude — families living inside the fortifications.
